gates.evidence: R1-01/21/23: dual-version structural schema, pinned A/B canonical roundtrip, signed receipt, 45 exact legacy hashes; no universal E2–E5 proof.

gates.name: Minimality & Reuse
gates.evidence: Actual restricted matched-scope comparison for two obligations (3 cases), controlled positive/negative R1 tests and necessity/reuse inventory. Full equal-scope alternate architecture and broad comparative minimality not established; no global minimum claimed. Do not waive original gate.

gates.name: Maintainability & Migration
gates.evidence: 9 independent controlled task groups / 10 measurement records, governed changes, method exchange, stale-evidence rejection, 0 code edits within tasks and 45 legacy hashes. No empirical human effort claim.

gates.name: Native Regression
gates.evidence: Exact latest implementation CI all three jobs successful; 30 R1 and 20 C5 tests, 116/116 original paths, zero C4 diff, upstream 4140 pass/47 skip.

gates.name: Integrated CBA Reference Demonstration
gates.evidence: 9 CBA reference variants migrated and executed native A/B with expected outcomes; synthetic, not full methodology.

gates.name: Final Specification
gates.evidence: Consolidated specification with exact C4 inheritance, dual-version metamodel/schema and independently executed structural checks; candidate is not a normative release.

gates.name: Critical Scientific Review
gates.evidence: Separate critical assessment, actual adversarial controls and residual-risk register; AI-authored, not person-independent audit; residual release blockers retained.

limitations: No scope reduction used to mark original gates MET. Candidate 0.2 is not v1.0 or regulatory approval.
